# camundacluster_group_member_user (Resource)

Assigns a user to a Camunda cluster group



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The ID of the group.
- `user_id` (String) The username of the user.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID of the assignment (group_id/user_id).
